label: MSC Cruises 🇨🇭

hover: Shipping + port infrastructure. 80% of global trade by volume moves by sea.

hover: Warehousing, freight forwarding, customs brokerage at port complexes.

hover: Piloting, tugboat, bunkering, vessel traffic, and port maintenance services.

hover: Farm-raised fish, shellfish, seaweed. Surpassed wild capture by volume in 2022 (FAO).

hover: Shrimp, crab, lobster, mussel farming. SE Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, India) dominates.

hover: Wild-caught fish. ~92M tonnes/yr globally. Stagnant since 1990s; sustainability pressure.

hover: Revenue ~$4.3B. World's largest canned tuna producer. Chicken of the Sea owner.

hover: Nutraceuticals, pharma, algae extracts, krill oil, marine enzymes. ~$7.9B (2024).

hover: Revenue $199M. Antarctic krill harvesting and processing. Superba krill oil brand.

hover: Revenue ~KRW 9.9T (~$7.4B). LNG carrier and drillship specialist.

hover: Revenue EUR 8.1B (~$8.8B). World leader in cruise ship construction + naval vessels.

hover: Engines, navigation, propulsion systems, deck machinery, marine electronics.
